An action is applicable only when all pre_on flags are set and every pre_off flag is unset. Its effect first unsets delete flags, then sets add flags; other flags persist. All actions and costs are listed; costs are positive integers. A goal state has every goal_on flag set and every goal_off flag unset. Minimize total cost over applicable action sequences; any optimal sequence is acceptable, including an empty one when already at the goal. Return {"actions":[name,...],"cost":integer}, or {"status":"IMPOSSIBLE"} if no sequence reaches the goal.
Records below use JSON values after field names. Record IDs are arbitrary; display order is not time order. Only records with exactly the requested scope belong to this task. Other scopes are separate workspaces.
